relationship_notes: ToneHome identifies the FF-III as made by Jen Electronica in Pescara and as a differently branded version of JEN FZ-III. Surviving Reverb examples also identify Italian manufacture and FBT branding.
Surviving example is identified as Italian-made FBT distortion with foot-controlled gain, Level and Tone controls. Factory relationship to JEN is not established from primary evidence.
Specialist historical material reports several FBT fuzz and wah products and some JEN rebranding. Do not assume all FBT products share one factory state.
